reason: This PR appears centered on core session/transaction behavior: it introduces a sysvar for `txn-entry-size-limit` and directly changes `pkg/session`, `pkg/sessionctx/variable`, `pkg/kv`, and `pkg/store/driver/txn`, with `pkg/planner/core/planbuilder.go` likely handling `SET` semantics.
